page_title: RSO 3-1 OSA | Real Sociedad v Osasuna 15/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
90+4' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) commits a foul and Guillermo Cuadra immediately signals a free kick.

90+3' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) does well to evade a couple of challenges then let's fly from distance towards goal, but the effort flies just wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
90+2' Kike Barja (Osasuna) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
90+2' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Remiro, who smothers the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Javi Galan (Osasuna) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
87' Ooh that was close! Kike Barja (Osasuna) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
86' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
85' Great teamplay by Real Sociedad as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
84' Here is a change. Jon Moncayola is going off and Alessio Lisci gives the last tactical orders to Asier Osambela (Osasuna).
84' A substitution has been made. Ander Barrenetxea goes off and Wesley (Real Sociedad) comes on.
82' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Guillermo Cuadra and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
82' Kike Barja (Osasuna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Remiro intercepts the ball.
81' A cross from Victor Munoz (Osasuna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
80' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
79' The attendance for today's match is 30856.
79' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the right post.
78' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
76' 3 - 1 Victor Munoz (Osasuna) receives a brilliant pass inside the box from Kike Barja, and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the roof of the net. He makes it 3:1.
76' The percentage of ball possession is – 48:52.
74' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
74' Substitution. Aimar Oroz walks off the pitch and Kike Barja (Osasuna) comes on as a substitute.
73' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
72' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
69' Pellegrino Matarazzo is forced to make a change. Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Orri Oskarsson.
64' Pellegrino Matarazzo decides to make a substitution. Brais Mendez will be replaced by Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad).
63' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Benat Turrientes as he is replaced by Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad).
63' A substitution has been made. Ander Barrenetxea is replaced by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
61' Dangerous play by Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad). Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
61' A dangerous towering header by Ante Budimir (Osasuna) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
60' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Osasuna.
60' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
60' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) on the edge of the box. Osasuna will take a corner kick.
60' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) will take a free kick in a very promising position.
59' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
59' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Osasuna earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
58' Alessio Lisci has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) replacing Alejandro Catena.
58' Referee Guillermo Cuadra sees the trip by Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.

57' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Sergio Herrera tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
55' A cross into the box from Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) is cleared.
54' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
54' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
53' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
52' 3 - 0 Goal! Benat Turrientes tees up Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the top right corner. 3:0.

51' The most active player in today's match is definitely Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
51' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Alex Remiro makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
50' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) takes the corner.
49' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
49' Now Osasuna have a corner.
46' Substitution. Raul Moro did his best and is replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
46' Alessio Lisci has decided to substitute Lucas Torro and he is replaced by Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
46' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is able to continue to play.
45+2' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

45+1' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
45+1' The linesman points to the corner flag, Osasuna are going to take it.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' 9:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
42' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
40' Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
36' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
35' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
34' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging some short passes.

28' 2 - 0 Goal! Benat Turrientes sets up Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
24' 1 - 0 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Sergio Herrera into the bottom left corner.
24' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
23' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) probably handled the ball. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Real Sociedad.
22' Chance! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Ander Barrenetxea, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the left post.
19' A cross from the by-line finds Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
18' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
18' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
16' Brais Mendez slides a brilliant pass into Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
16' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Sergio Herrera stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
15' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
14' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
12' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header only flies onto the right post and away off it!
10' Flag up against Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
8' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul after Lucas Torro (Osasuna) hacks down one of his opponents.
5' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) will deliver the corner kick.
4' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Alex Remiro makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
2' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
